note: Oracle for forge's #[slag] handling (§8). Hand-derived (R-CHAR-3). A VALID slag fn (all three fields present + non-empty) is EXEMPT from the L3 proof but its contract is still mandatory + enforced at L1 -> certifies level L1 with slag:true (NOT L3, NOT skipped). slag exempts PROVING, never STATING/checking: the §7.1 structural triage STILL applies (a slag fn with a vacuous contract is rejected; only the maximal-fx (d) check is justified by slag). Invalid slag metadata (missing/empty reason/owner/review) is rejected.

accept.name: simd_sum_l1
accept.program: #[slag(reason = "vendored SIMD intrinsics", owner = "agent:forge-7", review = "required")] fn simd_sum(xs: &[u32]) -> u64 req xs.len() <= 1000000 ens result == 0 fx pure { 0 }
accept.why: valid slag (all 3 fields non-empty), non-vacuous contract -> L1 + slag:true (L3-exempt, L1-enforced).

accept.name: slag_justifies_maximal_fx
accept.program: #[slag(reason = "raw FFI", owner = "agent:forge-7", review = "required")] fn g(x: u32) -> u32 req true ens result == x fx read(a), write(a), net(a), alloc, time, rand, panic, diverge { x }
accept.why: maximal fx WITH slag -> the (d) triage check does not fire; certifies L1 + slag:true.

reject.name: empty_reason
reject.program: #[slag(reason = "", owner = "agent:forge-7", review = "required")] fn f(x: u32) -> u32 req true ens result == x fx pure { x }
reject.why: reason is empty (§8 mandates non-empty reason/owner/review).

reject.name: missing_owner
reject.program: #[slag(reason = "vendored", review = "required")] fn f(x: u32) -> u32 req true ens result == x fx pure { x }
reject.why: owner field omitted (parser -> None; forge rejects).

reject.name: slag_vacuous
reject.program: #[slag(reason = "vendored", owner = "agent:forge-7", review = "required")] fn f(x: u32) -> u32 req true ens true fx pure { x }
reject.why: slag exempts PROVING, not STATING: a vacuous ens (a) is still rejected by §7.1 triage even on a slag fn.
